title: fix: document error details as optional
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Corrected the OpenAPI error schema so `error.details` is optional, matching `createErrorResponse()`, which includes it only when details exist. The correction applies to every route using `errorResponseDescriptions()`; for example, `/v1/models/{model}` 404 responses now require `code`, `message`, and `timestamp`, but not `details`. Added a regression test for the 404 schema.
